title: Ketones
caption: In a ketone the C=O is within the chain, with a carbon on each side, so there is no hydrogen on the carbonyl carbon to oxidise. Propanone is the simplest; ketones are named with -one.
alt: Propanone, butanone and cyclohexanone with the C=O shaded.
description: Cyclohexanone: the C=O in a six-membered ring.
